title: Structural Design Engineer – Bridge & Canal Designer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Structural Design Engineer** to design, analyze, and develop structural systems for **bridge, canal, and related infrastructure projects**. The role involves collaborating with architects, hydrologists, and construction teams to deliver safe, efficient, and cost-effective structural designs in compliance with national and international standards.

**Experience:** 4 to 7 Years

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and analyze **bridge components** such as decks, girders, piers, abutments, and foundations, as well as **canal structures** like aqueducts, siphons, regulators, falls, and retaining walls.
* Perform **structural analysis and design calculations** for RCC, PSC, and steel structures as per **IRC, IS, and MORTH** specifications.
* Develop and review **structural drawings, models, and reinforcement details** using AutoCAD and structural design software (STAAD Pro, MIDAS Civil, ETABS, etc.).
* Conduct **load assessments** including dead, live, impact, seismic, and wind loads; ensure structural safety and serviceability.
* Coordinate with **geotechnical, hydraulic, and architectural teams** for integrated design solutions.
* Review and approve **shop drawings, bar bending schedules (BBS)**, and vendor/contractor design submissions.
* Conduct **site inspections** to verify design implementation and provide technical guidance during construction.
* Prepare and maintain **design reports, technical documentation, and approval drawings** for submission to clients or authorities.
* Ensure designs adhere to applicable **IS, IRC, BIS, and international codes**, safety norms, and quality standards.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Civil or Structural Engineering** (Master’s preferred).
* 4–7 years of experience in **structural design for bridges, canals, or infrastructure projects**.
* Proficiency in **STAAD Pro, MIDAS Civil, AutoCAD**, and other structural analysis/design tools.
* Strong understanding of **bridge and hydraulic structure behavior**, load paths, and detailing practices.
* Knowledge of **MORTH, IRC, and IS codes** relevant to highway and canal projects.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills.
* Good communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **prestressed concrete bridge** design and **hydraulic structures** (aqueducts, siphons, regulators).
* Familiarity with **seismic and wind load design** for infrastructure projects.
* Working knowledge of **BIM tools** (Revit Structure, Tekla) or 3D modeling software.
* Prior experience with **government infrastructure projects** (NHAI, WRD, PWD, etc.).

title: Senior Experience Designer
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Experience Designers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in developing human-centered experiences that provide personalized, clear, helpful, and inclusive digital plus human solutions for our customers. Experience designers consider the why, what, and how of product use to help identify where user needs intersect with business goals across the entire user journey. As an Experience Designer, you will:  
  

* Leverage human-centered design methods (design-thinking, service design, research/insights etc.) to plan, create, and present persuasive, engaging, and strategic ideas that influence product roadmaps and demonstrate a solution's potential for success.

  

* Performs competitive analysis of direct/indirect competitors and monitors the marketplace for new trends to inform the research and design process.

  

* Translate business, contractual, technical, and user needs into end-to-end customer, employee, and 3rd-party experiences that are accessible, inclusive, and compliant.

  

* Designs omni-channel experiences that help customers meet their goals, are empathetic and easy to use, improve customer satisfaction, and drive deeper product adoption.

  

* Deliver experiences that have been validated through experimentation, testing and optimization.

  

* Conduct design within an agile environment and champion the integration of design across the entire release cycle (discover, deliver, and assess).

  

* Conform with reusability standards by leveraging and/or expanding the Design System and established platform capabilities.

  

* Manages across Enterprise users to define and deliver product performance goals (e.g., outcomes, customer experience, etc.).

  

* Collaborate with design peers and key stakeholders (Marketing, Brand, CX, etc.) to ensure artifacts and deliverables accurately represent and align to the U.S. Bank brand, and create interconnectivity across customer, client, and employee touchpoints for all business segments

Basic Qualifications
  

* User experience design experience

Preferred Skills/Experience
  

* Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators design systems, service blueprints, and reusability
* Demonstrates deep understanding of target customer through internal/external research (e.g., creation of personas, story maps, product chartering/mapping experience)
* Strong collaboration with product managers, software engineers, and agilists to execute product vision and roadmap
* Facilitation of cross-functional human-centered design sessions to build empathy for users, create alignment on customer pain-points, and to identify continuous improvements for the product roadmap
* Preferred skills: design-thinking, user-centered design, product strategy, vision and planning, product development, channel alignment and management, customer experience research, insight and execution, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics

title: UX Designer
description:
**Role Overview**


As a UX Designer at NETGEAR, you will craft intuitive, engaging interfaces for our enterprise and consumer networking products. You’ll partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Visual Design teams to translate complex networking concepts into clear, user\-centered experiences across web, mobile, and desktop platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **User Research:** Plan and conduct usability studies, interviews, and surveys to uncover user needs and pain points.
* **Interaction Design:** Develop wireframes, user flows, and prototypes that illustrate product functionality and user journeys.
* **Visual \& Information Design:** Create high\-fidelity mockups and design specs aligned with NETGEAR’s brand and design system.
* **AI\-Assisted Design \& Prototyping:** Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Figma Make, and other AI\-powered UX tools to accelerate ideation, research synthesis, UX writing, design exploration, and rapid prototyping.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively across devices.
* **Iteration \& Validation:** Gather feedback from stakeholders and end users; iterate designs to optimize usability and performance.
* **Documentation:** Maintain and evolve our UX guidelines, component libraries, and style documentation.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of complete UX Design experience, preferably on B2B, SaaS, enterprise, or networking products.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferably in UX/UI Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, or related field.
* **Tools \& Skills:**


	+ Strong proficiency with Figma (components, auto\-layout, prototyping).
	+ Experience with Figma Make and AI\-assisted prototyping workflows.
	+ Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, and other emerging AI tools for UX research, ideation, UX writing, and rapid prototyping.
	+ Familiarity with usability testing tools (e.g., UserTesting, Maze).
	+ Solid foundation in graphic design (typography, color, layout).
	+ Experience with web \& mobile app design strategies.
	+ Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles.
	+ Experience with AI tools for UX and product design.
* **Attributes:**


	+ Strong empathy and communication skills, able to articulate design choices.
	+ Analytical mindset with a focus on data\-driven design decisions.
	+ Ability to learn networking concepts quickly and translate them into user workflows.
	+ Collaborative spirit and comfort working in Agile/Scrum environments.
	+ A portfolio showcasing design process and outcomes.

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*
